primary_return: Method net excess total return at 10bp per side, actual French RF and zero-missing primary; report missing weights and adverse100/0/25bp sensitivities.
primary_benchmark: Actual French5 + MOM + fixed132 JKP identities (138 columns). No factor stand-ins, ridge residuals or favorable calendar intersections.
primary_calendar: 190 months: 2005-02-28 through 2020-11-30. Every decision follows the 2004-12-31 source-selection data cutoff.
estimand: 12 times monthly full-span OLS intercept after scale normalization; rank, intercept information and residual df must pass.
margin_basis: Carry forward the project previously fixed 2 percentage-point annual economic margin. Non-significance at zero is not absence of useful alpha.
inference: Newey-West Bartlett HAC, lag=floor(4*(n/100)^(2/9)), correction n/(n-rank-1), lag12 sensitivity. Pointwise99% intervals and two-sided zero-alpha pvalues remain descriptive approximate inference.
primary_positive_useful_alpha_test: One-sided H0 annual alpha <= .02 versus > .02 with HAC SE; conservative 69*p at family .01. Retain denominator69 without inventing pvalues or returns for unavailable papers.
family_bounds: Approximate one-sided99% Bonferroni lower/upper bounds using z=norm.isf(.01/69), distinct from pointwise99% intervals.
absence_rule: A claim excluding useful alpha requires an adjusted upper bound below .02. Otherwise inconclusive; failure to reject does not establish no alpha.
paired_baseline: Method-minus-native-control return intercept on identical dates/cost/missing paths. Verify paired intercept equals difference of arm intercepts. Diagnostic, not isolated causal LLM effect or another independent primary.
six_factor_diagnostic: Actual French5 + MOM only; keep separate and never substitute its favorable result for the primary full benchmark.
limitations: 190 months and138 full-rank factors leave51 residual df: identified does not mean powerful, or guarantee finite-sample HAC calibration.
Current served models and retrospective data/source development preclude pristine model snapshots or untouched-holdout claims.
Published factor returns are gross long-short series; this is risk attribution, not a fully costed factor-hedged investment product.
Methods share one market history; stockmonths, calls and factors are not independent paper trials.
Source-core U.S. monthly transfers retain explicit data/model/frequency/proxy limitations.
